name: GW BUS
description: An OpenAI-compatible gateway advertising starting credits.
overview: GW BUS advertises $5 signup credit and a 1M tokens/day Free-plan limit. The page does not establish that the credit replenishes; treat 1M/day as a ceiling inside a finite balance, not a recurring grant. Card requirements, expiry and eligible models are unclear. Neither signup nor inference was tested.
free_access: 1M/day is a limit, not a proven grant
notes: Base URL https://api.gwbus.com/v1. The docs show paid model prices and 402 on insufficient balance.
